text:
emily.r: Quick check-in  ChargePilot trial ends next week. Finance wants final confirmation on invoice structure before we sign a 12mo commit. Can someone pull the sanitized invoice lines?
kai: I grabbed the sanitized invoice from their portal. They separate "interactive calls" vs "batch tokens" and have a small per-run orchestration fee.
sam.p: paste the lines please so procurement can map to SKUs.
kai: pasted (sanitized):
```
CHARGEPILOT INTERACTIVE-CALL: 2,150 calls @ $0.035/call = $75.25
CHARGEPILOT BATCH-TOKENS: 980,000 tokens @ $0.00065/token = $637.00
CHARGEPILOT ORCH-FEE: 22 runs @ $3/run = $66.00
CHARGEPILOT EMBEDS: 12,500 vectors @ $0.0020/vector = $25.00
REGIONAL FEE (EUR): $8.50
TOTAL = $811.75
```
leah: Procurement asks: 1) can they include PO number on invoice and Net60? 2) can invoice lines include a sku_id column for our ingestion? 3) the "interactive-call" naming is ambiguous for our billing model.
mike (ChargePilot): Hi everyone  happy to clarify. Short answers: PO numbers + Net60 are fine for signed 12mo commits >= $75k ARR. We can produce invoice CSVs with sku_id, unit, qty, unit_price, currency. Interactive-call is a per-API-call metric for streaming/chat endpoints (includes small compute + token delta).
emily.r: Will they accept our token counts for reconciliation? We've seen a ~3% delta in trials.
mike (ChargePilot): We use a GPT-like BPE tokenizer. We can provide a tokenization script and a sample mapping. If you prefer Redwood counts as authoritative we can sign a reconciliation addendum (simple one-pager) and honor your counts for billing.
sam.p: Any discount tiers for 12mo commits and how are overages handled?
mike (ChargePilot): Standard discounts: 10% off list for 12mo >= $50k, 18% off for >= $120k, 24% off for >= $250k. Commits billed monthly with quarterly true-ups. Overage charged at list, but we cap year-over-year increases at 12%.
ai_procurement-bot: Reminder: Vendor risk form outstanding  ChargePilot provided link: https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/risk/chargepilot Assigned to @leah and @legal.team. Due in 6 days.
leah: Tax question: do you reverse-charge VAT for EU customers with VAT ID? Need explicit VAT_ID field on CSV.
mike (ChargePilot): Yes  we support reverse charge and will include VAT_ID and tax_summary columns. We also support EUR invoicing.
emily.r: Trial credits: we used $1,500 in trial credits. Can they be applied to first invoice/commit?
mike (ChargePilot): Trial credits will be applied as a one-time invoice credit on conversion. They don't count toward the commit minimum.
kai: Do you provide a usage export or webhook for near-real-time reconciliation?
mike (ChargePilot): Yes, we have a usage webhook and daily gzipped CSV exports. We'll include sku_id and a counts_toward_commit boolean in the CSV.
sam.p: One more: can they flag which line items count against the commit (very important for our finance model)?
mike (ChargePilot): Will include a "counts_toward_commit" flag per line and a separate column "billable_toward_commit" (yes/no).
leah: Great. Next steps: @mike please upload machine-readable CSV with sku_ids, attach tokenization script and a short reconciliation addendum draft, and confirm Net60+PO in writing if we hit >= $75k. @leah/legal will triage the vendor risk form. If we get the CSV today I'll run a 60-day projection and post results here.
mike (ChargePilot): Will do  uploading now and will send a formal quote showing the 18% discount for a $120k commit option. Happy to jump on a 15m call if helpful.
emily.r: Thanks all. If reconciliation addendum is quick we can automate ingestion and avoid manual reconciliation at renewal. :thumbsup:
